source: Samsung INDUCTION RANGE Service Manual (model code NSI6D*9500****)
content: C-20 Oven sensor opened (over 2950Ω) Oven sensor shorted. (Under 930Ω) 1. Disconnect power. Open the back cover. Disconnect sensor harness from control Measure sensor resistance :1080Ω at the room temperature → If there are any problems, replace oven sensor. 2. If there is not any problem with oven sensor, Please check whether there is a damaged terminal or wire harness. 3. Check resistance of oven sensor connector on Sub PCB (Normal:2850Ω)

metadata.solution:
1. Disconnect power. Open the back cover. Disconnect sensor harness from control Measure sensor resistance :1080Ω at the room temperature → If there are any problems, replace oven sensor.
2. If there is not any problem with oven sensor, Please check whether there is a damaged terminal or wire harness.
3. Check resistance of oven sensor connector on Sub PCB (Normal:2850Ω)

source: Samsung INDUCTION RANGE Service Manual (model code NSI6D*9500****)
content: C-21 Oven heating over 1. Disconnect power. Open the back cover. Disconnect sensor harness from control. Measure sensor resistance :1080Ω at the room temperature → If there are any problems, replace oven sensor. 2. Check the broil, bake and convection heater. Check the resistance of the each heater. 3. Check whether DLB, Broil, Bake and Convection heater relay are working normally. 4. Check whether there is any disconnection of harness which is linked with main PCB on sub PCB. 5. Check the resistance of oven sensor connector on sub PCB. (Normal : 2850Ω)

metadata.solution:
1. Disconnect power. Open the back cover. Disconnect sensor harness from control. Measure sensor resistance :1080Ω at the room temperature → If there are any problems, replace oven sensor.
2. Check the broil, bake and convection heater. Check the resistance of the each heater.
3. Check whether DLB, Broil, Bake and Convection heater relay are working normally.
4. Check whether there is any disconnection of harness which is linked with main PCB on sub PCB.
5. Check the resistance of oven sensor connector on sub PCB. (Normal : 2850Ω)

source: Samsung INDUCTION RANGE Service Manual (model code NSI6D*9500****)
content: C-d1 Door locking information 1. Disconnect power. Open the back cover.Check whether harness has been connected with door lock switch and motor. 2. Confirm whether resistance value of door lock motor is normal. 3. With operating door lockout, measure a voltage of connector on harness which is linked with door lock motor. (Normal Voltage : AC 120V) 4. Check whether door locking switch is working.

metadata.solution:
1. Disconnect power. Open the back cover.Check whether harness has been connected with door lock switch and motor.
2. Confirm whether resistance value of door lock motor is normal.
3. With operating door lockout, measure a voltage of connector on harness which is linked with door lock motor. (Normal Voltage : AC 120V)
4. Check whether door locking switch is working.

source: Samsung INDUCTION RANGE Service Manual (model code NSI6D*9500****)
content: Wi-Fi Connection is not working 1. Check whether Wi-Fi icon shown. 2. If the Wi-Fi icon is not displayed, register the range to SmartThings app by referring to the following instructions. 3. Make sure that the mobile phone is connected to 2.4GHz Wi-Fi network. 4. Do not use the hidden AP in the wireless router settings during the device registration. 5. Use a unique SSID consisting of the alphabetic letters and the numeric digits without any blank. 6. For Wi-Fi security protocols, WPA2-PSK_AES is recommended. 7. Press and for 3sec. (Long press) 8. If network version is shown normally, try to use SMART CONTROL feature again.

metadata.solution:
1. Check whether Wi-Fi icon shown.
2. If the Wi-Fi icon is not displayed, register the range to SmartThings app by referring to the following instructions.
3. Make sure that the mobile phone is connected to 2.4GHz Wi-Fi network.
4. Do not use the hidden AP in the wireless router settings during the device registration.
5. Use a unique SSID consisting of the alphabetic letters and the numeric digits without any blank.
6. For Wi-Fi security protocols, WPA2-PSK_AES is recommended.
7. Press and for 3sec. (Long press)
8. If network version is shown normally, try to use SMART CONTROL feature again.
